test.statistic: per member, equal-weight average over basket symbols of the daily net return series (bp, exit-day booking) on the common UTC-day grid of the window
test.method: two one-sided studentized bootstrap tests (stats_mc.stepm with a single series, i.e. K=1) of H0 mean <= 0, both at alpha, on (i) the bundle series and (ii) the beta-hedged bundle series; the bundle passes only if BOTH reject (intersection-union)
test.alpha_note: DECIDED 2026-10-22 (동동, ADR 0025): the forward-window family alpha 0.0304 is split by Bonferroni between v2 (this file, 0.7 x 0.0304 = 0.0213) and the walk-forward e-value v3 (0.3 x 0.0304 = 0.0091), because both use forward data from 2026-11. Sum = 0.0304, valid whatever the correlation of the two tests. Both gates (unhedged and beta-hedged) at 0.0213 (intersection-union). Previously 0.0304.
test.bootstrap_B_why: ADR 0022 side finding: with B=1000 the critical value cannot go below the max of 1000 draws (effective alpha ~0.001). B >= 20*m/alpha ~ 3300 is needed for alpha/m; 10000 used.
test.pass: both tests reject AND pooled events >= 60 AND >= 30 non-zero days (unchanged)
test.beta_report: required in the report; since D4 is decided it is also the second gate
test.beta_hedge: hedged_t = bundle_t - beta * basket_buy_and_hold_t, beta = OLS slope on the equal-weight 15-symbol buy-and-hold daily series, estimated on the window itself (no look-ahead issue because the series is only used for evaluation, not for trading); beta and the unhedged/hedged means are reported

single_use: RESERVED marker + window key appended to validation_window_history.jsonl before any member is evaluated; same mechanism as independent_window.py

power_table.method: normal approximation as ADR 0016/0017/0023, K=1 (D3), alpha 0.0213 (after the v2/v3 split), equal annual SR on each symbol, constant edge (an upper bound), pooling boost sqrt(M/(1+(M-1)rho)). The beta-hedged second gate (D4) lowers power further; treat as upper bounds.
power_table.rho_note: crypto daily returns across these symbols correlate ~0.6-0.8 in a market move; rho 0.6 is the realistic row. A signal that is mostly market beta is not helped by pooling and the 12m/rho 0.6 row is the honest one: needs annual SR ~2.2-2.7.
power_table.reading: The basket is the liquid 9 (Q1-B). rho 0.6 row: required annual SR 2.30 at 80% power (2.27 for the old 15). Upper bounds.

decided.D3: yes - the 5 members are tested as ONE bundle hypothesis (equal-weight daily series of the 5 members, then the basket average). K=1, one more degree of selection: the bundle is chosen on DEV (ADR 0024 top-5), reported as such.
decided.D4: yes - second gate: beta-hedged bundle series must also reject H0 (mean <= 0) at the same alpha. Intersection-union test: size <= alpha without splitting alpha; power <= the weaker of the two.
decided.D1: 12 months (2026-11-01..2027-10-31). Result earliest 2027-11. A second window of the same family (alpha spending k=2) rather than extending this one.
decided.D2: the assumed alt cost is replaced by a MEASURED alt cost (criteria cost_public_estimate_v2_alts.json, ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA) when one is sealed. To prevent cherry-picking, replacement is allowed only if the estimate is sealed BEFORE the freeze date (D5): then the universe rule, the member selection and the evaluation all use it, re-run from scratch. Sealed later: assumed_public_v1 stays for this window; the measured cost is reported alongside as a diagnostic.
decided.D5: members file frozen on 2026-10-31 (DEV-only evolve run on the then-current code, ADR 0023 entry rule DEV SR >= 1.0). If fewer than 5 members meet the entry rule, the window is not registered and nothing is spent.
decided.Q1: B 2026-10-24 by 동동 ("너의 추천으로 진행해", ADR 0037): liquid 9 basket + cost criteria v3_alts for D2

alpha_split.why_7_to_3: run/audit/evidence_evalue_v3_20261022/split_results.json: with both earning the same edge, P(either rejects by 36 months) is nearly flat across splits (SR2 0.67-0.68, SR3 0.90-0.96), so the split decides WHEN evidence arrives. 7:3 keeps v2's 12-month power within 2-4 points of the unsplit test (SR2 0.675 -> 0.626, SR3 0.900 -> 0.880) while v3 still reaches SR3 0.88 / SR2 0.37 by 36 months.
